observations.summary: The source deliberately separates mathematical perspective (Chs. 1-7) from fractal geometry (Chs. 8-9), matching the requested surgical audit scope.
Most foundational construction overlaps the five-book stack, but Chapters 2-3 provide exact projection and station-point mathematics useful as internal derivation rather than more beginner cards.
The two-point viewing semicircle gives a rigorous explanation of VP spacing, station-point recovery, and why a valid image can look distorted from ordinary viewing distance.
Chapter 6 contains the intended Deep deltas: acute three-point VP triangle/orthocenter geometry, exact viewing distance, skyscraper paradox, and a spherical projection alternative for extreme fields.
Anamorphosis and forced perspective strongly demonstrate viewpoint dependence but mostly specialize the already-emerging camera/projection logic; they do not require another foundation card.
The plates visually confirm the spherical/Termes examples but add no independent geometric rule.

rationale: The source earns the planned surgical Deep PASS because it can resolve the outstanding mathematical holds without reopening the artist-facing curriculum: viewpoint/display distortion, exact tilted/three-point camera geometry, COV claims, and the skyscraper/projection-model question.
